<OPTIONS>
/NODE=KM.ARIES
/UN=//
/PW=
/OLEDB=SQLPlus
/ENGINE=VA
/WORKDIR=.\
/T=No
/CSV=IIS.csv
/HEADERS=lot,operation,test_end_date,tester_id,test_name,all_value,testing_session_sequence,ws_loss_code,test_bond_head_id,test_end_work_week,summary_id,program_name,complevel_1,complevel_2,lane_number,carrier_x,carrier_y,testing_session_tray_id,testing_session_unit_id,visual_id,owner_type_name
/INSTANCE=8933
/USE_LEGACY_PIVOT_HEADERS=Y
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 1.1-a0. Fetching ARIES Data
/RECORD=AT_Metrology@1.0.0.0
/HADOOP_SERVER_DEFAULT=ATD_ATM.HADOOP
</OPTIONS>

/*BEGIN SQL*/
SELECT 
          ats.lot AS lot
         ,ats.operation AS operation
         ,To_Char(ats.test_end_date_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS test_end_date
         ,ats.tester_id AS tester_id
         ,t.test_name AS test_name
         ,CASE WHEN ctr.string_value IS NULL THEN to_char(ctr.numeric_result) ELSE ctr.string_value END AS all_value
         ,ats.testing_session_sequence AS testing_session_sequence
         ,dt.ws_loss_code AS ws_loss_code
         ,dt.test_head_id AS test_bond_head_id
         ,ats.test_end_work_week AS test_end_work_week
         ,ats.summary_number||ats.summary_letter AS summary_id
         ,ats.program_name AS program_name
         ,ctr.complevel_1 AS complevel_1
         ,ctr.complevel_2 AS complevel_2
         ,dt.lane_number AS lane_number
         ,dt.carrier_x AS carrier_x
         ,dt.carrier_y AS carrier_y
         ,dt.testing_session_tray_id AS testing_session_tray_id
         ,dt.testing_session_unit_id AS testing_session_unit_id
         ,di.visual_id AS visual_id
         ,ats.owner_type_name AS owner_type_name
FROM 
A_Testing_Session ats
INNER JOIN A_All_Component_Testing_Result ctr ON ctr.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = ats.ts_id AND (ctr.numeric_result IS NOT NULL or ctr.string_value is NOT NULL)
INNER JOIN A_Test t ON t.t_id = ctr.t_id
INNER JOIN A_Device_Testing dt ON dt.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND dt.ts_id = ats.ts_id
AND dt.lao_start_ww = ctr.lao_start_ww AND dt.ts_id = ctr.ts_id AND dt.dt_id = ctr.dt_id
LEFT JOIN A_Device_Item di ON di.di_id = dt.di_id
WHERE ats.data_domain='METROLOGY'
 AND      ats.lot In ('7549G419'
,'7550F062'
,'7603D983'
,'7604F833'
,'7606F719'
,'7607D328'
,'7607D609'
,'7608G116') 
 AND      ats.operation = '2090' 
 AND      ats.latest_flag = 'Y' 
 AND      (ats.tester_id LIKE  '%IIS%'
) 
 AND      ctr.complevel_2 = 'INSPRES' 
 AND      (t.test_name LIKE  'POSX%'
OR t.test_name LIKE 'POSY%'
) 
/*END SQL*/
